prompt_en: Photorealistic vertical eye-level medium-close documentary photograph in a security control room. One explicitly adult original woman works as the security guard. She is a pretty and cute adult woman in her late twenties with a polished bishoujo-inspired character-design read: harmonious refined adult facial features, clear lively almond-shaped eyes at realistic adult scale, a softly expressive mouth, glossy well-kept dark hair in a neat low ponytail, and cohesive professional styling. Her appealing face is the first-read focus, while her practical uniform, radio, and ID lanyard clearly preserve the security-guard role. Her baseline is exact stoic control; seven visitor badges stand in one perfectly aligned row on the counter. Freeze during the correction before order is restored. One visitor badge flips upside down when its clip catches on her radio cord. Her eyes widen for one beat, her lips part in a tiny caught breath, her shoulders jump, and one hand shields the inverted badge as if nobody noticed. Her other hand has only begun rotating it, so the card stays visibly upside down and a crooked open gap remains in the row. Her adult security-guard identity, practical uniform, ID lanyard, and control-room context remain readable. Her beautiful adult face, shielding hand, correcting fingertips, radio cord, inverted badge, and open gap share one tight focal plane; background monitors stay softly legible but subordinate. Clean cool overhead light with a gentle warm face fill gives her lively eyes clear catchlights while retaining natural skin, glossy hair, fabric creases, metal clips, and realistic hand contact. Nonsexual, affectionate everyday gap comedy without humiliation or glamour posing.
